device.description: 16-bit 1 MSPS single-channel unipolar SAR ADC with SPI/DSP serial interface and daisy chain
device.note: ads8330.pdf (SLAS516C) p.3-7 electrical characteristics (+VBD 1.65-5.5 V), p.9 timing at +VBD = 1.8 V, p.10-11 pin assignments and terminal functions, p.25 start of a conversion, EOC/INT, p.26-27 power-down, p.29 digital interface, p.30 Table 4 CMR commands, p.31 Table 5 CFR, p.32 Table 6 codes, p.35 Table 7, p.36 reset

registers.name: CFR
registers.note: p.31 Table 5: configuration register; D8 default 1 (table), D1 TAG enable ignored, always reads 0; no address (CMR commands 1100b/1110b/1111b)

commands.name: Wake up
commands.note: p.26-27: sets CFR D3 and D2 to 1 (not D4)

commands.name: Read CFR
commands.note: p.31: the read-back is the first four result MSBs then the 12-bit CFR

commands.name: Write CFR (D0 = 0: system reset)
commands.note: p.31 Table 5 D0: 0 = system reset (registers to default)

commands.name: Write CFR
commands.note: p.30: 4-bit command plus 12 bits of CFR data, effective at the 16th SCLK falling edge

commands.name: Default mode (load CFR with default value)
commands.note: p.30: CFR loaded with its default at the 4th falling edge (SDI tied to +VBD gives this every cycle)

pages: p.3-7 (electrical characteristics: +VBD 1.65-5.5 V, digital inputs to +VBD + 0.3 V), p.9 (timing at +VA = 2.7 V, +VBD = 1.8 V: internal CCLK 20 MHz min, td(SCLKF-SDOVALID) 16 ns, td(CSF-SDOVALID) 13 ns, td(CSR-SDOZ) 8 ns), p.10-11 (pin drawings and terminal functions), p.25 (18-CCLK conversion, CONVST falling edge, auto trigger, EOC/INT), p.26-27 (power-down), p.29 (digital interface), p.30 (Table 4 CMR), p.31 (Table 5 CFR, reading the conversion result), p.32 (Table 6 straight binary), p.35 (Table 7), p.36 (reset)
notModeled: analog input and external reference: every conversion returns the 0 V code 0000h

conversion time is 18 CCLK at the 20 MHz minimum internal clock (+VBD = 1.8 V table, 900.0 ns); CCLK = SCLK/2 (CFR D10 = 0), the 21-CCLK auto-trigger cycle (D9 = 0) and the minimum CONVST spacing are not timed; with auto trigger the model converts back to back
quiet zone around end of sampling and the pipelined result (FS/CS falling before the end of conversion reads the previous result): the model always outputs the constant 0 V code
SDO outputs all 1s during the first cycle after power-on or software reset (the model outputs the normal frame)
daisy-chain mode (CFR D5 = 0: EOC/INT/CDI becomes the chain data input, 16/24-SCLK pass-through); with D5 = 0 the pin is left inactive
power-down modes: deep power-down (D2), nap (D3), auto nap (D4) and their wake-up times; CFR bits are stored only, Wake up sets D3/D2
the 4-bit CMR is not readable; the CFR read-back reply starts after the 4 command bits (the 4 result MSBs before it are the frame's normal output)
SPI mode: the part samples SDI and changes SDO on SCLK falling edges and works with CPOL = 0, CPHA = 1 or CPOL = 1, CPHA = 0 (p.29); modeled as mode 2
CMR 0h/1h channel select commands apply to the dual-channel sibling only (ignored here)
variants: ADS8330 (2-channel: +IN1/+IN0/COM, CMR 0h/1h channel select, TAG bit D1) shares ads8330.pdf; own spec. ADS8327/ADS8328 (ads8327.pdf) are the 500 kSPS versions; ADS7279/ADS7280 the 14-bit versions.
